clientConnection.onlyInClient: This page is only available in the Bakabase client.
clientConnection.address.label: Server address
clientConnection.address.tip: The address the server's settings page shows, e.g. 192.168.1.5:34567.
clientConnection.thisDevice: This device introduces itself as "{{name}}" · client {{version}}
clientConnection.pair.title: Pair with {{name}}
clientConnection.pair.description: This server has to let you in before it will serve you. Either type a code from its settings page, or ask a device that is already paired to approve this one.
clientConnection.pair.waiting: Waiting for someone to approve this device…
clientConnection.servers.label: Servers this client knows
clientConnection.servers.none: None yet. Connect to one above.
clientConnection.forget.title: Forget this server?
clientConnection.forget.description: This client will drop its key for {{name}} and have to pair again. Nothing on the server is changed.
clientConnection.handshake.Unreachable: Nothing answered at that address. Check that the server is running and that you can reach it. {{detail}}
clientConnection.handshake.NotBakabase: Something answered, but it is not a Bakabase server. {{detail}}
clientConnection.handshake.ClientTooOld: That server is newer than this client. Update the client. {{detail}}
clientConnection.handshake.ServerTooOld: That server is too old for this client. Update the server. {{detail}}
clientConnection.handshake.RemoteAccessD: That server is not serving other devices. Turn on remote access in its settings.
clientConnection.handshake.SelfAddress: That is this client's own address. Enter the address of the computer running Bakabase — its settings page shows it.
clientConnection.pairing.CodeRejected: That code was not accepted. Generate a new one on the server and try again.
clientConnection.pairing.RequestRejected: The request was turned down, or it expired.
clientConnection.pairing.TooManyAttempts: Too many attempts from this device. Wait a few minutes and try again.
clientConnection.pairing.PairingUnsuppor: That server is too old to pair with.
clientConnection.serverUpdate.available: A new version of {{name}} is available
clientConnection.serverUpdate.pendingRes: {{name}} has to restart to finish updating. Anyone else using it will be disconnected while it does.
clientConnection.managedByDesktop: This window belongs to the Bakabase desktop app, which decides the devices it can show. Manage them from the desktop app's Devices page.
